WITH strips AS (
  SELECT
    instrument_id,
    param_id,
    substring(subsystem FROM '^Ava(.+)$') AS type,
    component AS model
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND subsystem IN ('AvaBaa', 'AvaBda', 'AvaFib', 'AvaSem')
    AND component ILIKE '%strip%'
),

replacement AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (d.instrument_id, d.param_id)
         d.instrument_id,
         d.param_id,
         d.time AS last_changed
  FROM data d
  JOIN strips s USING (instrument_id, param_id)
  WHERE d.value_num = 0
  ORDER BY d.instrument_id, d.param_id, d.time DESC
)

SELECT
    UPPER(s.type) AS "Type",
    s.model AS "Model",
    COUNT(s.param_id) AS "Total apertures",
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(r.param_id) >= 2
        THEN MAX(r.last_changed)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "Last replacement"
FROM strips s
LEFT JOIN replacement r
  USING (instrument_id, param_id)
GROUP BY s.type, s.model
ORDER BY s.type

panels.description: For each aperture, the last 10 current measurements from the last week are considered. The measured values  above 500% of the target are ignored

targets.rawSql:
WITH
-- Get the param_ids for the parameters we need
param_ids AS (
    SELECT
        instrument_id,
        MAX(param_id) FILTER (WHERE param_name IN ('BeamCurrentFIBParameter', 'BeamCurrentMeasuredParameter')) AS measured_param,
        MAX(param_id) FILTER (WHERE param_name = 'BeamCurrentTargetParameter') AS target_param,
        MAX(param_id) FILTER (WHERE param_name = 'SelectedBDAIndexParameter') AS index_param
    FROM parameters
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
      AND component = 'FIB'
    GROUP BY instrument_id
),

erosion_params AS (
    SELECT
        instrument_id,
        param_id,
        (substring(param_name FROM '(\d+)$')::int + 1) AS aperture_idx
    FROM parameters
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
      AND subsystem IN ('AvaBda', 'AvaFib')
      AND component ILIKE '%strip%'
),

-- find zero erosion values for each aperture
replacement AS (
    SELECT
        d.param_id,
        MAX(d.time) AS last_changed,
        p.aperture_idx
    FROM data d
    JOIN erosion_params p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
    WHERE d.value_num = 0
    GROUP BY d.param_id, p.aperture_idx
),

time_range AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(MAX(last_changed), now() - interval '1 week') AS time_from,
        now() AS time_to
    FROM replacement
),

-- Extract target current change intervals. The BDA index is changed a few seconds later
target_changes AS (
    SELECT
        start_time,
        end_time,
        state/1e12 AS target_current
    FROM state_int_timeline(
            (
                SELECT state_agg(d.time, (d.value_num*1e12)::bigint) -- use pA to convert to integers
                FROM data d
                         JOIN param_ids p
                              ON p.instrument_id = d.instrument_id
                                  AND p.target_param = d.param_id
                WHERE d.time >= (SELECT time_from FROM time_range)
                  AND d.time < (SELECT time_to FROM time_range)
        )
    )
),

-- Lateral join data table, for each interval we find the index and median measured current
results AS (
    SELECT tc.start_time,
           tc.end_time,
           agg.bda_index,
           tc.target_current,
           agg.measured_current,
           p.index_param,
           p.measured_param
    FROM target_changes tc
             CROSS JOIN param_ids p
             JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT MIN(CASE WHEN d.param_id = p.index_param THEN d.value_num::int END) AS bda_index,
               approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(CASE WHEN d.param_id = p.measured_param THEN d.value_num END)) AS measured_current
        FROM data d
        WHERE d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
          AND d.param_id IN (p.index_param, p.measured_param)
          AND d.time >= tc.start_time
          AND d.time < tc.end_time
        ) agg ON true
    ORDER BY tc.start_time
),

-- Fill the NULL indices with LOCF, filter out abnormal currents and compute degradation %
results_filtered AS (
    SELECT r.start_time AS time,
           COALESCE(r.bda_index, (SELECT r2.bda_index
                                  FROM results r2
                                  WHERE r2.end_time < r.end_time
                                    AND r2.bda_index IS NOT NULL
                                  ORDER BY r2.start_time DESC
                                  LIMIT 1)) AS bda_index,
           r.target_current,
           r.measured_current,
           (r.measured_current - r.target_current) / r.target_current * 100.0 AS degradation
    FROM results r
    WHERE r.measured_current > 0.95 * r.target_current
      AND r.measured_current < 5 * r.target_current
    ORDER BY r.start_time
),

-- Aggregate per BDA index
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY bda_index
               ORDER BY time DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM results_filtered
),

-- Average the last 10 measurements
degradation AS (
    SELECT
        bda_index,
        target_current,
        approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(measured_current)) AS avg_current,
        approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(degradation)) AS avg_degradation
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn < 11
    GROUP BY bda_index, target_current
    ORDER BY bda_index
),

-- Calculate stats for erosion time
erosion_time AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.aperture_idx)
        p.aperture_idx,
        d.value_num AS erosion_time
    FROM data d
             JOIN erosion_params p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
    WHERE d.instrument_id = $instrument 
    ORDER BY p.aperture_idx, d.time DESC
),

daily_erosion AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket_gapfill(
                '1 day',
                day,
                start  => (SELECT time_from FROM time_range),
                finish => (SELECT time_to FROM time_range)
        ) AS day,
        aperture_idx,
        COALESCE(daily_erosion, 0) AS erosion
    FROM fib_bda_counters_daily
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument 
      AND day >= (SELECT time_from FROM time_range)
      AND day < (SELECT time_to FROM time_range)
),

avg_erosion AS (
    SELECT
        aperture_idx,
        approx_percentile(0.5, percentile_agg(erosion)) AS avg_daily_erosion
    FROM daily_erosion
    GROUP BY aperture_idx
)

SELECT
    e.aperture_idx AS "Aperture index",
    d.target_current AS "Target current",
    d.avg_current AS "Avg beam current",
    d.avg_degradation AS "Avg degradation",
    e.erosion_time/3600.0 AS "Erosion time (h)",
    du.avg_daily_erosion/3600.0 AS "Avg daily usage"
FROM erosion_time e
LEFT JOIN degradation d ON d.bda_index = e.aperture_idx
LEFT JOIN avg_erosion du ON du.aperture_idx = e.aperture_idx
ORDER BY e.aperture_idx, d.target_current

WITH erosion_params AS (
    SELECT
        instrument_id,
        param_id,
        component,
        (substring(param_name FROM '(\d+)$')::int + 1) AS aperture_idx
    FROM parameters
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND subsystem = 'AvaBaa'
      AND component ILIKE '%strip%'
),

component_value AS (
    SELECT component
    FROM erosion_params
    LIMIT 1
),

lifetimes AS (
    SELECT
        CASE component
            WHEN 'BaaStripZeus_PN1112942'
                THEN ARRAY[300,300,300,1000,1000,1500,1500,500,NULL]
            ELSE NULL
        END AS lifetime
    FROM component_value
),

erosion_time AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.aperture_idx)
        p.aperture_idx,
        d.value_num/3600.0 AS erosion_time
    FROM data d
    JOIN erosion_params p USING (instrument_id, param_id)
    ORDER BY p.aperture_idx, d.time DESC
),

daily_usage AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket_gapfill(
            '1 day',
            day,
            start  => now() - interval '1 week',
            finish => now()
        ) AS day,
        aperture_idx,
        daily_erosion
    FROM fib_baa_counters_daily
    WHERE day >= now() - interval '1 week'
),

avg_daily_usage AS (
    SELECT
        aperture_idx,
        avg(COALESCE(daily_erosion, 0)) AS avg_daily_usage
    FROM daily_usage
    GROUP BY aperture_idx
)

SELECT
    p.aperture_idx AS "Aperture index",
    e.erosion_time AS "Erosion time (h)",
    l.lifetime[p.aperture_idx] AS "Lifetime (h)",
    du.avg_daily_usage/3600.0 AS "Avg daily usage"
FROM erosion_params p
JOIN erosion_time e USING (aperture_idx)
LEFT JOIN avg_daily_usage du USING (aperture_idx)
CROSS JOIN lifetimes l
ORDER BY p.aperture_idx

WITH erosion_params AS (
    SELECT instrument_id,
           param_id,
           (substring(param_name FROM '(\d+)$')::int + 1) AS index
    FROM parameters
    WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
      AND subsystem = 'AvaSem'
      AND component ILIKE '%strip%'
)

SELECT
    p.index AS "Aperture index",
    d.value_num / 3600.0 AS "Erosion time (h)"
FROM erosion_params p
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT value_num
    FROM data d
    WHERE d.instrument_id = p.instrument_id
      AND d.param_id = p.param_id
    ORDER BY d.time DESC
    LIMIT 1
) d ON true
ORDER BY p.index
